content: In our case study, we qualitatively found that paragraphs were the optimal level of context for analysis; full articles often focused on topics unrelated to LGBTQ communities, even if an LGBTQ label was mentioned somewhere in the article, while single sentences did not provide enough discussion to get a sense of how LGBTQ groups are represented by the newspaper. Thus, we calculate paragraph-level scores by taking the average valence score over all words in the paragraph that appear (or whose lemmas appear) in the NRC VAD lexicon.
